map.输入面料缩水率与成衣目标尺寸，可正向预测水洗后成品尺寸，也可反算裁剪时的放缩尺寸: Enter the fabric shrinkage rate and the target garment size to predict the finished size after washing, or back out the cut dimensions that offset the shrinkage, used to correct patterns and guarantee garment specifications.
map.缩水率 = (原尺寸 - 水洗后尺寸) / 原尺寸 × 100%: Shrinkage rate = (original size − size after washing) / original size × 100%
map.按面料缩水率修正成衣尺寸，支持裁剪尺寸反算与成品尺寸预测: Correct garment dimensions for the fabric shrinkage rate, supporting both back-calculating cut dimensions and predicting finished size
map.测裁片洗前洗后尺寸算缩水率: Measure a pattern piece before and after washing to get the shrinkage rate
map.按目标成品尺寸反推裁尺寸（放缩水）: Back out the cut size from the target finished size (adding shrinkage allowance)
map.不同洗涤条件下缩率对比选预缩工艺: Compare shrinkage under different wash conditions to choose a preshrinking process
map.：裁 100 cm、洗后 95 cm → 缩水率 = (100 - 95) /: : Cut 100 cm, 95 cm after washing → shrinkage = (100 - 95) / 100 × 100% = 5%, i.e. 5 cm per metre.
map.：要成品 100 cm、缩水率 5% → 裁尺寸 = 100 / (1 - 5%: : For a finished 100 cm at 5% shrinkage → cut size = 100 / (1 - 5%) ≈ 105.3 cm; cutting shorter leaves the product short.
map.经向纬向缩率一样吗？: Is the Warp and Weft Shrinkage the Same?
map.通常经向（长）缩率大于纬向（宽），裁布需分别放缩。: The warp (lengthwise) shrinkage is usually greater than the weft (widthwise), so cutting fabric needs scaling in each direction separately.
map.预缩可大幅降低成衣再缩，但回潮与整理残留仍会有残余缩率，需留余。: Preshrinking greatly reduces further shrinkage of the finished garment, but re-moisturizing and finishing still leave a residual rate, so leave margin.
